name: Stop sign
meaning: An eight-sided sign reserved for stop signs.
action: Stop completely, then give the right-of-way to pedestrians and all cross traffic before moving again.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: These eight-sided signs are reserved for stop signs.  These signs mean you must stop completely. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and to all cross traffi  c before moving again.

name: Yield sign
meaning: A downward-pointing triangle telling you that other traffic has the right-of-way.
action: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to cross traffic or to merging traffic before you proceed.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.section: Single Message Shaped Signs - Triangle (upside down)
source.sourceQuote: This shape requires that you yield the right-of-way to cross traffi  c or to merging traffi  c.

name: No-passing zone pennant
meaning: A pennant-shaped sign on the left side of the road marking the start of a no-passing zone.
action: Do not begin to pass from this point until the no-passing zone ends.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: This sign marks the beginning of a no-passing zone.

name: Railroad advance warning
meaning: A round yellow-and-black sign giving advance warning of a railroad crossing ahead.
action: Slow down, look and listen for a train, and be ready to stop before the tracks.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: This yellow-and-black sign gives advance warning of a railroad crossing ahead.

name: School zone / school crossing
meaning: A five-sided sign warning of a school zone ahead or marking a school crossing.
action: Slow to the 15 m.p.h. school zone limit when children are present or when specified, and watch for children.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: The maximum speed limit in a school zone is 15 m.p.h. when children are present or when specifi ed.

name: Speed limit sign
meaning: A white rectangular regulatory sign showing the fastest speed allowed under optimal weather and road conditions.
action: Do not exceed the posted number, and drive slower whenever conditions are less than ideal.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: These signs show the fastest speed you may drive under

name: General warning sign
meaning: A yellow diamond with black symbols or letters warning of possible danger ahead.
action: Slow down, read the symbol and be ready for the hazard it shows.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: These  diamond-shaped signs will usually appear without  explanatory words beneath them.  These signs are yellow with black letters.  They warn of possible danger ahead and may have symbols or written warnings.

name: Pedestrian crossing warning
meaning: A pedestrian or school warning sign, which may be yellow-green with black letters.
action: Slow down and watch for, and yield to, people walking across the road.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Pedestrian and school warning signs may be yellow-green with black letters.

name: Construction and maintenance sign
meaning: An orange diamond notifying drivers of unusual or potentially dangerous conditions in or near a work area.
action: Slow down, expect workers, equipment and lane shifts, and follow the channelling devices.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Construction and maintenance signs are used to notify drivers of unusual or potentially dangerous conditions in or near work areas.

name: Railroad crossbuck
meaning: Black letters on white bars in the shape of an X, marking the railroad crossing itself.
action: Yield to all trains, and never enter the crossing unless you can clear the tracks completely.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Railroad crossing signs can be round or diamond shaped, yellow with black symbols, or  black letters on white bars in the shape of an X called a crossbuck.

name: Guide sign
meaning: A white-on-green sign telling you where you are, what road you are on and how to get where you are going.
action: Read it early and change lanes in good time for your exit or turn.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Most guide signs are white on green. Motorist services signs are white on blue.   Signs for parks and public recreation areas are white on brown.

name: Motorist services sign
meaning: A white-on-blue sign showing what amenities are available off the exit.
action: Use it to plan fuel, food and rest stops rather than making a late decision at the ramp.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Most guide signs are white on green. Motorist services signs are white on blue.   Signs for parks and public recreation areas are white on brown.

name: Park and recreation sign
meaning: A white-on-brown sign for parks and public recreation areas.
action: Follow it for the park or recreation area; it is a guide sign, not a warning.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote: Most guide signs are white on green. Motorist services signs are white on blue.   Signs for parks and public recreation areas are white on brown.

name: Wrong Way sign
meaning: A red horizontal sign warning that traffic in that direction is prohibited.
action: Do not continue in that direction; if this sign faces you, you are travelling against the flow and will likely meet another vehicle head-on.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
Wrong Way or Do Not Enter - These signs
warn  you  that  traffic  in  that  direction  is
prohibited.

name: One Way Street sign
meaning: A horizontal sign telling you when a cross street carries traffic running in one direction only.
action: Turn into the street only in the direction the sign allows; where there are one-way streets, the next consecutive block usually runs the opposite way.

source.sourceDocument: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook (Rev. 07/2026, retrieved 2026-09-14, SHA-256 45082246ab6df6c75d0968a680b6a7ad26d334aeb2e547871dea3fd7c7828a7a)
source.sourceQuote:
One  Way  Street -  This  sign  is
used to tell you when a cross
